questions.q: In Azure Firewall Policy, which rule collection type filters by FQDN (such as *.windowsupdate.com) instead of IP address?
options: NAT rules
Network rules
Application rules
Default rules
questions.explain: Application rules filter by fully qualified domain name, letting you allow a domain without tracking its changing IP ranges — something network rules (5-tuple) can't do.

questions.q: What language does AWS Network Firewall's stateful rule engine use?
options: A proprietary YAML format unique to AWS
The same JSON Firewall Policy syntax as Azure Firewall
Standard IAM policy JSON
Suricata-compatible rule syntax, the same language used by the open-source Suricata IDS/IPS engine
questions.explain: AWS Network Firewall's stateful rule groups are written in Suricata-compatible syntax, including FQDN-style filtering via keywords like tls.sni.

questions.q: How does traffic actually get routed into Azure Firewall from a workload subnet?
options: The firewall is automatically inserted at the VNet boundary with no routing changes needed
A user-defined route (UDR) sends 0.0.0.0/0 from the workload subnet to the firewall's private IP as the next hop
Workload subnets must peer directly with AzureFirewallSubnet using NSG rules
DNS is repointed to the firewall's public IP
questions.explain: Azure Firewall only sees traffic that's explicitly routed to it — a UDR on the workload subnet forces 0.0.0.0/0 through the firewall's private IP.

questions.q: What is a real operational difference between Azure Firewall and AWS Network Firewall deployment?
options: Azure Firewall cannot inspect HTTPS traffic under any SKU
AWS Network Firewall deploys one endpoint per Availability Zone, meaning routing is wired per AZ, while Azure Firewall is a single regional instance in one dedicated subnet
Azure Firewall only works with App Service, not virtual networks
AWS Network Firewall has no concept of rule priority
questions.explain: AWS Network Firewall places a firewall endpoint in each AZ you cover, so each protected subnet's route table points at the endpoint in its own AZ — a per-AZ wiring model Azure Firewall doesn't need.

questions.q: Which Azure Firewall SKU adds TLS inspection and an IDPS engine?
options: Basic
Standard
Premium
There is no SKU distinction — all tiers include TLS inspection
questions.explain: Standard covers network/application/NAT rules and threat intelligence filtering; Premium adds TLS inspection, IDPS, and URL filtering on top.
